verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents NVLink or any other high-bandwidth GPU-to-GPU interconnect for this card, and gives no first-party multi-GPU or rack-scale deployment guidance. The only interconnect cited is PCIe Gen 5 for CPU-to-GPU transfers, and NVIDIA positions the card for desktop work "without relying on costly cloud or data center resources." A community four-card build is a user-side arrangement, not a documented product capability. A critic also notes it has weaker SM interconnect and less library support than datacenter Blackwell parts.
